description: This file contains functions for platform-specific upgrade procedures, including image verification, partition comparison, and the process to perform system upgrades on a device, specifically for platforms based on the bcm27xx architecture.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks whether the image partition layout matches the existing device configuration, and warns if changes are detected.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the system upgrade, handling partition image writing, device repartitioning, and UUID updates based on the image provided.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration backup files to the device's boot partition and restores the configuration.
